items.html: For at first the coupling of AA was in the secret of kisses, as mentioned, to bring out Zeir and his Nukva through these two EHEYEH, which are in the throat of Arich, which are two EHEYEH for the need of ZON, one for ZA and one for the Nukva, and understand this. For as mentioned above, they are two EHEYEH corresponding to AVI. So from there it is drawn to ZA and to the Nukva. And these two EHEYEH are what is written, "EHEYEH ASHER EHEYEH," as explained above. Afterward these drops descended to the Yesod of Arich, and from there to the Malchut of Arich, and from there to Aba, and from there to Ima, as shall be written in the coming chapter, with the help of God. And there, in Ima, it remained in the secret of ibbur, and there it was fully corrected. And this Ima is the secret of the third name EHEYEH, as it is written, "EHEYEH has sent me to you."
